abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.
